mechanism: Independently read all12 coordinator source ranges937lines, including complete EndDragonFight537/respawn enum100/item61, then expanded actual global save bridge and crystal setters. Installed End-only world owner restores first-kill receipt, killed/scan state, live dragon UUID, portal and ordered remaining gateway pool. Missing pool reconstructs shuffled20 seeded defaults; present empty remains exhausted. Legacy initial scan derives prior completion from actual exit portal and resolves live dragon. Actual death checks tracked UUID, places first egg only if not previouslyKilled, removes next gateway from finite persistent pool, then marks completed. XP actual consumer distinguishes old completion flag. saveData preserves those completion facts but hardcodes isRespawning=false and omits respawn stage/time/crystal owner list. Actual later server save snapshots owner into PrimaryLevelData then global MinecraftServer.saveAllChunks calls worldData.createTag through LevelStorageSource.saveDataTag, compresses temporary file and safeReplaceFile. No separate credit for save helper/phase/crystal/field.
dedup: Recommend at most1 only for actual persistent shared-world encounter entitlement with consumptive finite unlock sequence and durable-vs-transient recovery boundary. Accepted80dd/b868 only moved old root owner and explicitly left consumer unaudited; this review adds actual completion consumer rather than second root-format credit. Accepted Raid23e6 recovers wave counters and selectively pays currently resolved online heroes; EndFight instead owns permanent global first-kill entitlement and finite gateway sequence across repeated encounters, rather than per-player pending hero reward. UUIDfixfba is representation helper0. Whole boss chain upper bound1, no new perflag/pergate/perphase credits; coordinator final semantic judgment.
